findings.evidence: design.md decision 6 specifies `hosted-preflight --mode ci --class <review|branch|post-merge> --repo owner/repo`. tasks.md 1.1 lists `--mode ci`, `--class`, `--repo`. The implementation in template/scripts/hosted_workers.py add_parsers defines only `--mode`, `--class` and `--phase`, with no `--repo`. Its class table is `review` and `finalize`, which matches the proposal and spec but not design decision 6. The spec requirement itself is satisfied. The design and tasks wording is stale.
findings.summary: The hosted-preflight command line differs from what design.md and tasks.md describe. The class set and the `--repo` option do not match.

findings.evidence: proposal.md Impact says "No change ... to downstream templates" and names only `template/scripts/lifecycle_workers.py`. The diff adds `template/scripts/hosted_workers.py` and changes `template/scripts/_platform_common.py`, which gains a new `is_credential_name` helper. It also changes `template/dev-platform/protected-surface.toml`, adding two protected entries, and `template/dev-platform/platform-manifest.json`. The tasks.md `[x]` marks for 1.x and 5.1 reference the manifest regeneration only indirectly, so the artifacts do not describe the shipped-template and protected-surface effect.
findings.summary: The proposal's Impact section says nothing changes for downstream templates and lists only `template/scripts/lifecycle_workers.py`. The candidate also adds and changes shipped template files.
